title: Uses 360 on a straight line
description: Uses 360 on a straight line — a wrong angle-reasoning pathway computed from the displayed givens.
typicalIncorrectMethod: Applies the rule 360 - sum(givens) to the given angles.
feedback: Angles on a straight line sum to 180 degrees, not 360. Subtract the given angles from 180.

title: Returns the sum of the givens
description: Returns the sum of the givens — a wrong angle-reasoning pathway computed from the displayed givens.
observableError: Gave the sum of the given angles.
typicalIncorrectMethod: Applies the rule sum(givens) to the given angles.

distractorRule.summary: Returns the sum of the givens

feedback: You added the given angles. Subtract their total from 180 to find the unknown.

title: Forgot one given angle
description: Forgot one given angle — a wrong angle-reasoning pathway computed from the displayed givens.
observableError: Left out one of the given angles.
typicalIncorrectMethod: Applies the rule 180 - sum(all but one given) to the given angles.
feedback: Include every given angle. Subtract the total of all of them from 180.

title: Uses 360 for a triangle
description: Uses 360 for a triangle — a wrong angle-reasoning pathway computed from the displayed givens.
observableError: Used a 360-degree sum for a triangle.
typicalIncorrectMethod: Applies the rule 360 - A - B to the given angles.
feedback: The interior angles of a triangle sum to 180 degrees, not 360.

title: Returns the sum of the givens
description: Returns the sum of the givens — a wrong angle-reasoning pathway computed from the displayed givens.
observableError: Gave the sum of the two known angles.
typicalIncorrectMethod: Applies the rule A + B to the given angles.

distractorRule.summary: Returns the sum of the givens

feedback: You added the two known angles. Subtract their total from 180.

title: Subtracts only one given
description: Subtracts only one given — a wrong angle-reasoning pathway computed from the displayed givens.
observableError: Subtracted only one known angle from 180.
typicalIncorrectMethod: Applies the rule 180 - A to the given angles.
feedback: Subtract both known angles from 180, not just one.

title: Forgot to halve
description: Forgot to halve — a wrong angle-reasoning pathway computed from the displayed givens.
observableError: Did not halve after subtracting the apex.
typicalIncorrectMethod: Applies the rule 180 - apex to the given angles.
feedback: After subtracting the apex from 180, share the result equally between the two base angles (divide by 2).

title: Halved 180 instead of (180 - apex)
description: Halved 180 instead of (180 - apex) — a wrong angle-reasoning pathway computed from the displayed givens.
observableError: Used 90 - apex instead of (180 - apex) divided by 2.
typicalIncorrectMethod: Applies the rule 90 - apex to the given angles.
feedback: Subtract the apex from 180 first, then divide by 2.

title: Base equals apex
description: Base equals apex — a wrong angle-reasoning pathway computed from the displayed givens.
observableError: Took the base angle to equal the apex.
typicalIncorrectMethod: Applies the rule apex to the given angles.
feedback: The base angles are not equal to the apex; use base = (180 - apex) divided by 2.

title: Uses 180 around a point

typicalIncorrectMethod: Applies the rule 180 - sum(givens) to the given angles.
feedback: Angles around a point sum to 360 degrees, not 180.

title: Uses the supplementary angle
description: Uses the supplementary angle — a wrong angle-reasoning pathway computed from the displayed givens.
observableError: Used the supplementary angle (180 - given) instead of the equal vertically opposite angle.
typicalIncorrectMethod: Applies the rule 180 - theta to the given angles.
feedback: Vertically opposite angles are equal, so the answer equals the given angle (do not use 180 minus the angle).
